changelog: Compatibility: targets Jellyfin 12.0.0.0 stable release with plugin version 1.8.2.0. Fixes: resolves library selection by replacing single-select with multi-library selection, adding select all/deselect all buttons, selected count badge, multi-library filter in pools view, and direct settings navigation. Dependencies: updates to Jellyfin 12.0.0 stable and 10.11.11 fallback.
description: Fill a local poster pool per movie from providers, then periodically rotate the Primary Poster image from the pool. This keeps Jellyfin looking fresh with rotating poster images on an interval of your choosing.
name: Poster Rotator
